title: EPCLM-002-A0 — Persistent State Recall

scope.primary_question: Can a learned cellular state preserve random episode-specific key-value facts and answer queries after the Writer process ends and raw history is removed?
scope.h1: Persistent Memory Survival across process and context removal.
scope.h2: Query-conditioned sufficiency of a learned state under independent episode mappings.
scope.h3: Selective retrieval from a small candidate set without scoring or reading every Cell.
excluded: generalization beyond the registered task distribution

adjacent_assets_found: History Compression 001: frozen historical calibration budget ladder; it is not a future-query episodic memory test.
Native CLM v0 M3L-1/M3L-2: persistent query-address sketches on language-model streams; these do not implement the A0 synthetic KV task.
Constructive CLM-005: learned routing/write/growth control over persistent cells; its task is not episodic key-value recall.
TextNCA and CLM validation implementations exist, but none was identified as a reusable isolated Writer/Reader recall runner.
repository_inspection.x3_x4_context: Do not assume historical CLM X3/X4 assets are present or canonical; locate and verify any relevant source during future project-wide history review.
repository_inspection.implementation_decision: Add an experiment-only module under scripts/research and register it under the existing continual-learning-core stage. Do not modify MiniCells core model code or existing experiment outcomes.

task.generator: PCG/stdlib deterministic PRNG keyed by split seed and episode index; each episode independently samples its own mapping.
task.query_count: one query for every final fact, sampled only after the Writer subprocess exits
task.episode_mapping: No fixed Key->Value mapping exists across episodes. Values are re-sampled independently. Keys are unique within an episode except in explicit overwrite cases.
task.distractor_definition: Non-factual 64-bit events with no key/value label; they are interleaved with valid facts and must not be counted as additional facts.

context_removal.forbidden_raw_data_path_guard: Reader installs a Python audit hook that rejects opens under the removed raw-data root.
context_removal.state_integrity: SHA-256 is recorded before and after Reader execution; the bytes must remain unchanged.
negative_controls: No state: Reader must abstain and return no prediction.
Wrong episode state: use independently sampled episode state and measure exact recall against the target episode.
context_removal.leakage_decision: Any Reader access to raw history, writer input, evaluator mapping, or training/test source invalidates the affected condition.

models.full_context_oracle: Evaluator-only upper bound; returns the known target and is never presented as a memory model.
models.no_memory: Deterministic query-only guess; expected exact-match chance is 1/65536.
models.direct_address: Explicit serialized key->value dictionary; engineering reference only and never evidence for learned Cell memory.

flat_recurrent.implementation: Learned single-vector GRU memory; persistent state has the same byte budget as the cellular candidate.

learned_cells.implementation: Learned event-to-cell encoder and learned query/key/value readout; one latent cell per write event; checkpointed model weights are shared across episodes.
learned_cells.training_address_supervision: For training episodes only, the latest matching factual event index supplies an auxiliary slot target. The Writer and Reader do not receive slot labels at inference.
learned_cells.candidate_scoring: All valid latent cells are scored, so this candidate is a full-scan H2 model and cannot pass H3.

models.learned_sparse_router: NOT_IMPLEMENTED in A0 v1; the registered learned-cell candidate explicitly scans all Cells. A separate sparse retrieval mechanism requires a new protocol version and must not be claimed from A0.

training.model_selection: lowest development-validation objective; test episodes are never visible

metrics: query exact-match accuracy, overall and by fact/distractor condition
overwrite new-value accuracy and stale-old-value rate
logical and serialized state bytes and checkpoint bytes
candidate Cells scored, Cells read, and full_scan flag
Writer termination, raw-input deletion, Reader allowlist and state-hash checks

decision_rules.h1_supported: Direct-address engineering reference passes process isolation, serialization integrity, no-state abstention, and wrong-episode controls. Report as protocol/mechanism evidence only.
decision_rules.h2_supported: Learned-cells passes every H2 threshold on all three formal model seeds; direct-address results do not count.
decision_rules.h3_supported: A learned candidate passes H3 recall, candidate fraction, and no-full-scan gates. The v1 learned-cells candidate cannot satisfy this rule because it full-scans.
decision_rules.overall_status: Report H1/H2/H3 separately as PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL, INVALID, or INCONCLUSIVE. Never merge a reference result into a learned-model claim.
decision_rules.formal_incomplete: If fewer than three formal model seeds or 1000 episodes per condition complete, report PILOT/PARTIAL, not formal support.
